# A genuine pre-certification data dir

Generated by the LAST PRE-MD BUILD — commit 73b238e ("lock screen: typed
twice…"), the parent of MD-0 — running this program from a worktree at that
commit:

    rt, _ := node.Open(dir, []byte("test passphrase"), "curator")
    tid, _ := rt.CreateSpaceWithOptions("Official Directory", node.CreateOptions{
        Policy: terminals.SpacePolicy{
            Visibility: terminals.VisibilityPublic, Join: terminals.JoinOpen,
        },
    })
    rt.Say(tid, "release notes: 0.1.1", node.SayOptions{})
    rt.Say(tid, "welcome to the quiet directory", node.SayOptions{})

So: keystore arity 19 (no cert store, no legacy bindings), a public
directory whose history contains NO identity.device_certified.v1 — exactly
the shape of a real catalog published before device certification existed.
NOT an emulation: these bytes came out of the old build.

`tid` holds the space id; the passphrase is "test passphrase".
Used by premd_compat_test.go. Do not regenerate casually — the point of the
fixture is that it stays OLD.
